Event

Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration

Sun, Sep 27, 2026, 10:00 AM → Tue, Oct 20, 2026, 10:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

This event has ended.

A US-only retail event for the card game's 30th anniversary at participating Best Buy, GameStop and Target stores.

SEE CURRENT EVENTS

At participating stores

  • Mega Gengar appears more often in Mega Raids.
  • Open the game while you're at the store to get a free three-step Timed Research with Gastly-family encounters, Gastly Candy and items.

Deadlines

  • Pick up the research by Oct 20 at 10:00 p.m. local time; you then have until Nov 20 to finish it.

Gift card bonus

  • Redeeming a Pokémon GO gift card bought at those retailers gives a Gengar Knit Cap avatar item (one per account).

Tip

You have to physically visit a participating US store to get the research.

Written by Trainer Desk from the official announcement, checked October 18, 2026. Details can change, so check in game. See all upcoming GO events or the live event tracker for raid bosses and counters.
